name: Loose Slab
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
description: The stone slab tears free from its track with the ear-piercing sound of failing metal.
disable: DC 20 Crafting check (expert) to shore up the track so that it functions as intended, or DC 18 Thievery check (trained) to wedge the slab in place to immobilize it

offensiveAbilities.name: Falling Slab
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to move the slab;

Effect The slab rips free from its track and falls, slamming down in one direction while it kicks up twisted metal debris in the other. All creatures adjacent to the slab take 3d6 bludgeoning and 3d6 piercing damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save).
